parameters.description: Choose whether dark or light source mass becomes the foreground tile.

parameters.label: Rule Pressure
parameters.description: How strongly neighboring infection or gravity overrides direct image reconstruction.

formParameters.label: Printed folds
formParameters.description: Flat body and fold faces with separate ink lines.

formParameters.label: Line spacing
formParameters.description: Space between ink ribs without changing the body geometry.

formParameters.label: Line weight
formParameters.description: Fine engraved lines through heavier ink.

formParameters.label: Knot Body
formParameters.description: Rest existing anatomy and explore the knot body.

formParameters.label: KONE Element
formParameters.description: Keep the KONE body in the active Form stack.

formParameters.label: KONE Shell
formParameters.description: Show the folded KONE ribbon or let its botanical growth live without the shell.

formParameters.label: Flower Element
formParameters.description: Keep flower bodies in the active Form stack.

formParameters.label: Flower Presence
formParameters.description: Bypass or reveal flower bodies without losing their anatomy.

formParameters.label: Growth Element
formParameters.description: Keep flower spread and botanical reach in the active Form stack.

formParameters.label: Growth Presence
formParameters.description: Bypass or reveal botanical reach without losing its settings.

formParameters.label: Center Ovals Element
formParameters.description: Keep the dark center apertures in the active Form stack.

formParameters.label: Center Ovals Presence
formParameters.description: Bypass or reveal the center apertures without losing their amount.

formParameters.label: Body Radius
formParameters.description: Scale of the underlying ring relative to the shorter canvas edge.

formParameters.label: KONE Size Difference
formParameters.description: Make the second KONE smaller or larger than the first.

formParameters.label: KONE Separation
formParameters.description: Pull two KONE bodies apart along a seed-held direction.

formParameters.label: KONE Position Scatter
formParameters.description: Let the complete KONE body drift away from the canvas center.

formParameters.label: Axis Stretch
formParameters.description: Flatten the ring into a disc or pull it into a long pod.

formParameters.label: Lobes
formParameters.description: How many repeated breaths gather around the body.

formParameters.label: Breath Depth
formParameters.description: Strength of swelling and pinching; values above one can turn the body through itself.

formParameters.label: Opening
formParameters.description: Below one tears the circle open; above one makes overlapping revolutions.

formParameters.label: Rib Count
formParameters.description: From exposed graphic anatomy to dense veil and moire.

formParameters.label: Twist
formParameters.description: Pressure that changes how the ring turns into folded structure.

formParameters.label: Turn
formParameters.description: Rotate the body and its inner fold through a recoverable viewing angle.

formParameters.label: Wound
formParameters.description: Smooth connected swelling and constriction rather than independent static.

formParameters.label: Fold Depth
formParameters.description: Move the third fold through and beyond the body; negative values reverse it.

formParameters.label: Mutant Symmetry
formParameters.description: Let opposite and repeated parts develop unequal reach, weight, and direction.

formParameters.label: Missing Organ
formParameters.description: Excise a deterministic territory so Void becomes part of the anatomy.

formParameters.label: Inner Body
formParameters.description: Grow a smaller inverted body inside or through the first.

formParameters.label: False Mouths
formParameters.description: Open slits and apertures where this body should not be able to speak.

formParameters.label: Growth Spread
formParameters.description: Move from one flower body into a dense botanical event around KONE.

formParameters.label: Flower Size
formParameters.description: Scale each flower body without changing how many grow.

formParameters.label: Growth Reach
formParameters.description: Contract the whole botanical ecology close to its source or let it travel across the field.

formParameters.label: Bloom Sites
formParameters.description: Choose whether flowers orbit KONE, occupy its wounds, or grow from folded rib ends.

formParameters.label: Graft Depth
formParameters.description: Move flowers from separate orbit into KONE

formParameters.label: Position Scatter
formParameters.description: Disperse flowers away from their orderly orbit using the held seed.

formParameters.label: Clustering
formParameters.description: Gather separate blooms into uneven colonies.

formParameters.label: Surface Attraction
formParameters.description: Pull flowers toward the breathing surface of KONE.

formParameters.label: Bridge Growth
formParameters.description: Grow flowers through the living interval between two KONE bodies.

formParameters.label: Orchid Presence
formParameters.description: Transform abstract buds into the selected orchid body.

formParameters.label: Orchid Species
formParameters.description: Choose Cattleya, the Taiwan lady

formParameters.label: Back Petals
formParameters.description: Keep the two faint petals behind the orchid body.

formParameters.label: Narrow Sepals
formParameters.description: Keep the three narrow sepals around the orchid.

formParameters.label: Wide Petals
formParameters.description: Keep the two broad side petals.

formParameters.label: Ruffled Lip
formParameters.description: Keep the violet folded lip body.

formParameters.label: Throat Oval
formParameters.description: Keep the long pale oval inside the lip.

formParameters.label: Center Oval
formParameters.description: Keep the small central oval where the orchid gathers.

formParameters.label: Short Veins
formParameters.description: Draw the three short veins inside the orchid lip.

formParameters.label: Paired Leaves
formParameters.description: Keep the two broad pleated leaves beneath the Pouch.

formParameters.label: Living Chamber
formParameters.description: Keep the suspended pouch body and its interior cavity.

formParameters.label: Contour Veins
formParameters.description: Let fine botanical lines describe pressure across leaves and pouch.

formParameters.label: Pouch Size
formParameters.description: Keep the chamber minute like field evidence or let it dominate its leaves.

formParameters.label: Chamber Pressure
formParameters.description: Collapse the pouch toward a thin husk or inflate it into a vessel.

formParameters.label: Mouth Opening
formParameters.description: Move the dark cavity from a sealed seam toward an exposed interior.

formParameters.label: Pouch Split
formParameters.description: Divide the chamber into two related but separating bodies.

formParameters.label: Pouch Inversion
formParameters.description: Turn the chamber away from its leaves until inside and outside exchange places.

formParameters.label: Grass Leaves
formParameters.description: Keep the few narrow basal leaves that anchor the signal to the ground.

formParameters.label: Signal Stalk
formParameters.description: Keep the nearly empty line that carries the spiral bloom sequence.

formParameters.label: Tiny Blooms
formParameters.description: Keep the small half-open orchid marks climbing around the stalk.

formParameters.label: Stalk Height
formParameters.description: Separate the height of the plant from the scale of its tiny flowers.

formParameters.label: Tiny Bloom Size
formParameters.description: Move the flowers from almost typographic signals toward individually readable bodies.

formParameters.label: Spiral Turns
formParameters.description: Loosen the flowers into a slow climb or tighten them into a botanical transmission.

formParameters.label: Bloom Count
formParameters.description: How many tiny orchid marks occupy the upper stalk.

formParameters.label: Missing Beats
formParameters.description: Remove deterministic flowers so the spiral reads as an interrupted score.

formParameters.label: Signal Drift
formParameters.description: Bend the governing line without dissolving its upward rhythm.

formParameters.label: Broken Spine
formParameters.description: Kink the body

formParameters.label: Leaf Reach
formParameters.description: Let botanical veins and petal spines extend farther from their growth.

formParameters.label: Second KONE
formParameters.description: Mix a displaced second KONE body with the first.

formParameters.label: Impossible Seam
formParameters.description: Cut and reconnect the surface along a displaced spiral fault.

formParameters.label: Gravity Wound
formParameters.description: Make one territory sag as if its structure has become too heavy.

formParameters.label: Possession
formParameters.description: Let an invisible inner pressure push selected anatomy outward.

formParameters.label: Ritual Mutation
formParameters.description: Grow invented crowns, horns, banners, and ceremonial extensions.
